page_title: ARG 3-3 FRA (PEN: 4-2) | Argentina v France 18/12/2022, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 121' That's it. The end of the match.
121' Gonzalo Montiel (Argentina) gives no chance to the keeper and converts the penalty with a sharp low drive into the left side of the net.
121' Goal! Randal Kolo Muani (France) takes just a short run up and buries the penalty into the roof of the net.
121' Emiliano Martinez (Argentina) is given a yellow card.
121' Goal! Leandro Paredes (Argentina) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Hugo Lloris to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom left corner.
121' Aurelien Tchouameni (France) can't convert the spot kick. It goes narrowly wide of the left post.
121' Paulo Dybala (Argentina) steps up to take the penalty and converts it with a low shot into the middle of the goal.

121' Kingsley Coman (France) places the ball on the penalty spot and sends it towards the bottom left corner. His effort isn't powerful enough, allowing Emiliano Martinez to dive and keep the ball out with an excellent save.
121' Goal! Lionel Messi (Argentina) puts the penalty low into the middle of the goal and past Hugo Lloris.
121' Goal! Emiliano Martinez gets a hand on the penalty from Kylian Mbappe (France), but can't stop it from flying inside the left post.
121' It is sometimes said that a penalty kick can only be missed by the taker rather than saved by the goalkeeper. Do you think that will be in the minds of the players today?
120+4' The referee blows for the end of the second period of extra-time.
120+4' Lautaro Martinez (Argentina) connects with a cross from the side, but produces a header which goes miles wide of the right post.
120+3' Randal Kolo Muani (France) receives a great pass inside the box and misses a golden chance. The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save.
120+3' The game is interrupted as Lionel Messi (Argentina) is flagged offside.
120+1' Lionel Scaloni decides to make a substitution. Nicolas Tagliafico will be replaced by Paulo Dybala (Argentina).
120+1' Jules Kounde goes off the pitch and Axel Disasi (France) comes on.
120' We will have 3 min. of added time.
120' Kylian Mbappe swings the cross over. Randal Kolo Muani (France) gets his head to it but it goes just wide of the right post.
120' Lionel Messi (Argentina) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
118' 3 - 3 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Kylian Mbappe (France) into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Emiliano Martinez no chance!
117' Kylian Mbappe (France) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
116' Gonzalo Montiel (Argentina) is punished with the yellow card.
116' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Gonzalo Montiel (Argentina). PENALTY to France!
116' Kylian Mbappe (France) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
116' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for France.
116' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Alexis Mac Allister walks off the pitch to be replaced by German Pezzella (Argentina).
115' Ibrahima Konate (France) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The referee blows his whistle, France are awarded a corner kick.
114' Leandro Paredes (Argentina) makes a really bad tackle on his opponent and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
113' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ibrahima Konate (France) comes onto the pitch for Raphael Varane.
108' 3 - 2 Goal! A rebound wrong foots everyone except Lionel Messi (Argentina), and he slams the ball into the open net from close range. 3:2.

108' Excellent touch by Lautaro Martinez (Argentina)! He latches on to a precise pass deep into the box and produces a low drive towards the right post. The goalkeeper pulls off a beautiful save to deny him.
108' Lionel Messi (Argentina) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the bottom right corner, but Hugo Lloris makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best!
106' Szymon Marciniak blows for the start of the second period of extra time.
105+2' The referee blows his whistle for the end of the first half in extra-time.
105+1' What a huge chance for Lautaro Martinez (Argentina). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post.
105+1' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Lionel Messi (Argentina), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

105+1' Gonzalo Montiel (Argentina) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. It will be a corner kick for Argentina.
105' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
105' Lautaro Martinez (Argentina) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
105' Marcos Acuna (Argentina) beats the defender to the ball in the box and shoots, but the ball flashes high over the bar.
102' The manager makes a subsitution with Lautaro Martinez (Argentina) coming on for Julian Alvarez.
102' Lionel Scaloni has decided to make a change. Leandro Paredes (Argentina) replaces Rodrigo de Paul.
101' Raphael Varane (France) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
101' Kingsley Coman (France) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
100' Kingsley Coman (France) dinks a fine lofted pass from the free kick. However, one of the defenders heads the ball out of danger.

100' Gonzalo Montiel (Argentina) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation. France earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
99' Randal Kolo Muani (France) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
98' Kingsley Coman (France) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
98' Rodrigo de Paul (Argentina) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for France.
98' Marcos Acuna (Argentina) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
97' Kylian Mbappe (France) is forced to stop his forward run after being caught in an offside position by the linesman.
96' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Youssouf Fofana (France) replaces Adrien Rabiot.
95' Szymon Marciniak has a clear sight and sees a foul from Marcos Acuna (Argentina).
94' Lionel Messi (Argentina) is penalised for holding. Szymon Marciniak signals a set piece.

93' Alexis Mac Allister (Argentina) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box well wide of the left post.

92' Marcus Thuram (France) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Szymon Marciniak with no other option than to blow for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Argentina.
91' Rough tackle by Adrien Rabiot (France). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
91' Lionel Scaloni has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Gonzalo Montiel (Argentina) replacing Nahuel Molina.
91' Extra time will now be played as the result of this match was not decided in normal time.
90+9' The referee has ended the second half.
90+8' Marcos Acuna (Argentina) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
90+8' The corner from Lionel Messi (Argentina) is hurriedly cleared.

90+7' Lionel Messi (Argentina) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the roof of the net. Hugo Lloris pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed. The referee signals a corner kick to Argentina.
90+6' Nicolas Tagliafico (Argentina) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent.
90+5' Having seen unsporting behavior, Szymon Marciniak shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Olivier Giroud (France) is the recipient.

90+4' Adrien Rabiot (France) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot low towards the middle of the goal. However, Emiliano Martinez anticipates the shot and makes an easy save.
90+4' The corner is swung in but France can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

90+3' Fantastic run and shot from mid-range by Kylian Mbappe (France), but a defender denies him an almost certain goal by getting his body in the way. France force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
90+3' Kylian Mbappe (France) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
90+3' Kylian Mbappe (France) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
90+2' Cristian Gabriel Romero (Argentina) trips an opposition player and Szymon Marciniak signals a foul.
90+1' Marcus Thuram (France) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
90' 8 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Adrien Rabiot (France) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
89' Adrien Rabiot (France) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
87' Marcus Thuram (France) is yellow-carded for breaking the rules of the game.
87' PENALTY APPEAL after Marcus Thuram (France) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
87' Kylian Mbappe (France) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
85' Kylian Mbappe (France) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
84' Enzo Fernandez (Argentina) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.

81' 2 - 2 Goal! Kylian Mbappe (France) shows good awareness inside the box as he latches on to a brilliant pass and fires a first-time shot into the back of the net. Marcus Thuram assisted in the goal. 2:2.
80' 2 - 1 Goal! Emiliano Martinez gets a hand on the penalty from Kylian Mbappe (France), but can't stop it from flying into the bottom left corner.
80' Kylian Mbappe (France) is going to take the penalty!
79' Foul! Nicolas Otamendi (Argentina) is penalised for pulling back his opponent. PENALTY! One of the players from France is about to take a penalty kick.
78' Half-chance! Rodrigo de Paul (Argentina) plays a pass into the box, but Hugo Lloris reacts well to snuff out the attack.
77' Eduardo Camavinga (France) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle.
74' Aurelien Tchouameni (France) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Szymon Marciniak blows for a foul.

72' Enzo Fernandez (Argentina) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Hugo Lloris pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
71' Here is a change. Theo Hernandez is going off and Didier Deschamps gives the last tactical orders to Eduardo Camavinga (France).
71' It is time for a substitution. Kingsley Coman (France) is on for Antoine Griezmann.
71' Kylian Mbappe (France) shows off his skills with a mazy run to the edge of the box and then fires in a disappointing shot that flies high over the bar.
69' Enzo Fernandez (Argentina) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle.
68' Randal Kolo Muani (France) leaps to meet the corner, but fires his header back across goal from close in and it goes well wide of the left post.
68' Antoine Griezmann (France) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
67' Theo Hernandez (France) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to France.
67' Antoine Griezmann (France) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Randal Kolo Muani, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
66' The attendance for today's match is 88966.
64' The referee allows time for a substitution. Angel Di Maria will be replaced by Marcos Acuna (Argentina).
63' Julian Alvarez (Argentina) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Alexis Mac Allister, but Hugo Lloris displays great awareness to stop him.
62' Theo Hernandez (France) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
62' The shots on goal statistics – 5:0.
60' CHANCE! Angel Di Maria finds Lionel Messi (Argentina) with a sweet pass, but he can't find the target as his effort from inside the box goes just wide of the right post!
60' Kylian Mbappe (France) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
59' Hugo Lloris pulls off a great save to deny Julian Alvarez (Argentina), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom left corner.
58' Kylian Mbappe (France) tackles a bit over-zealously and Szymon Marciniak blows for a foul.
57' Randal Kolo Muani (France) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for France.
57' Rodrigo de Paul (Argentina) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
56' Looks like Rodrigo de Paul (Argentina) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
55' Adrien Rabiot (France) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
53' Lionel Messi (Argentina) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
53' Nahuel Molina (Argentina) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. Argentina will take a corner kick.
52' Antoine Griezmann (France) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.
51' Kylian Mbappe (France) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger. Now France have a corner.

50' Rodrigo de Paul (Argentina) gets on the end of a cross inside the box and sweeps the ball goalwards towards the middle of the goal, but Hugo Lloris is well positioned and easily deals with the effort.
48' A raking crossfield pass from Raphael Varane (France) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
46' Enzo Fernandez (Argentina) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Hugo Lloris comes off the line to clear the ball away.
46' The second half has just started.
45+8' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+8' Antoine Griezmann (France) sends in a cross from a long-range free kick. However, his effort lacks accuracy and the ball sails off the pitch.
45+7' Enzo Fernandez (Argentina) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Szymon Marciniak had an easy-decision to make.
45+5' France seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
45+3' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 6:0.
45+2' It looks like Theo Hernandez (France) saw red with that tackle. Szymon Marciniak won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' Julian Alvarez (Argentina) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
42' Szymon Marciniak blows his whistle after Randal Kolo Muani (France) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
41' Didier Deschamps has decided to substitute Ousmane Dembele and he is replaced by Randal Kolo Muani (France).
41' Here comes a substitution. Marcus Thuram (France) is brought on as a substitute for Olivier Giroud.
41' Szymon Marciniak blows the whistle, Jules Kounde (France) is penalised for a foul.

41' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Argentina are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.

36' 2 - 0 GOAL! Alexis Mac Allister finds himself with the ball at his feet in space after a lightning counter attack. He looks and up slides the ball to Angel Di Maria (Argentina), who coolly slots the ball past the keeper from close in. It’s 2:0.
33' Alexis Mac Allister (Argentina) receives a deflected pass on the edge of the box and smashes the ball at goal. Unfortunately for him, it's well wide of the right post.
31' Angel Di Maria (Argentina) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball is out of play. France will have a throw-in.
30' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Lionel Messi (Argentina) offside.
29' Lionel Messi (Argentina) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
29' Lionel Messi (Argentina) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Argentina have been awarded a corner kick.
29' Theo Hernandez (France) is penalised for a foul. Szymon Marciniak had a clear view and blows his whistle.
27' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Antoine Griezmann (France), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
27' Antoine Griezmann (France) will take a free kick. Is he going to strike the ball directly at the goal? Let's find out!

26' Cristian Gabriel Romero (Argentina) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Szymon Marciniak blows his whistle for an infringement. France are awarded a free kick.
25' Kylian Mbappe (France) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
23' 1 - 0 Goal! Lionel Messi (Argentina) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Hugo Lloris into the bottom right corner.
22' Lionel Messi (Argentina) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
21' Szymon Marciniak blows his whistle after Ousmane Dembele (France) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Argentina are about to take a penalty!
20' Jules Kounde (France) makes a slide tackle, but referee Szymon Marciniak blows for a foul.
20' Szymon Marciniak blows his whistle and it's Olivier Giroud (France) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
19' Antoine Griezmann (France) will take the free kick.
19' Rodrigo de Paul (Argentina) brings an opponent down and Szymon Marciniak interrupts the game. Another situation results in a direct free kick for France.
18' Ousmane Dembele (France) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. It's a throw-in for France.

16' A short pass from Rodrigo de Paul puts Angel Di Maria (Argentina) in the clear inside the box with just the keeper to beat, but his shot sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and France will have a goal kick.
16' The ball possession at the moment is 55:45.
15' Angel Di Maria (Argentina) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
15' Lionel Messi (Argentina) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
13' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Julian Alvarez (Argentina) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
12' Angel Di Maria (Argentina) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
11' Hugo Lloris (France) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
10' Hugo Lloris (France) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
9' Szymon Marciniak blows his whistle as Cristian Gabriel Romero (Argentina) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
9' The resulting corner from Lionel Messi (Argentina) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

8' Rodrigo de Paul (Argentina) meets a cross just outside the area and gets in a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The ball is out of play. Argentina will have a chance to score from a corner.
7' Julian Alvarez (Argentina) jumps into a tackle and Szymon Marciniak signals a foul.
5' Alexis Mac Allister (Argentina) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards goal, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper.
5' Angel Di Maria (Argentina) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball has crossed the sideline. Argentina are taking a throw-in.
4' Dayot Upamecano (France) makes a rough challenge and Szymon Marciniak blows his whistle for a foul.
3' Julian Alvarez (Argentina) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
3' Angel Di Maria (Argentina) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
2' Rodrigo de Paul (Argentina) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. Free kick. France will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
1' Adrien Rabiot (France) commits a rough challenge and Szymon Marciniak blows his whistle for a foul.
